literal: The consequence he does not consider, proper things he does not do, disgrace he does not consider, good character he lacks—to enemies (he is) easy.
translation: One who does not consider the consequences of his actions, does not do what is proper, does not fear disgrace, and lacks good character is an easy prey for his enemies.
modern: செயலின் விளைவை ஆராயாதவன், நன்மையானவற்றைச் செய்யாதவன், பழிக்கு அஞ்சாதவன், நற்பண்புகள் இல்லாதவன் ஆகிய இவன் தன் பகைவர்களுக்கு மிக எளியவன் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the flaws that make a person highly vulnerable to their adversaries. First, such a person does not look ahead to the consequences of their actions ('வழி நோக்கான்'). Second, they fail to perform deeds that are proper or beneficial ('வாய்ப்பன செய்யான்'). Third, they are indifferent to the disgrace or blame their actions might bring ('பழி நோக்கான்'). Finally, they lack basic good character ('பண்பிலன்'). A person with these four defects becomes an effortless target ('இனிது') for their enemies ('பற்றார்க்கு') to overcome.
